provenance: New mechanism synthesized from SG22 pass-depth, SG27 cross-scale agreement, SG30 second-pass inflation, and SG31 background-support findings; not a reproduction of an external paper
ca: historical A3 selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all CA heads, ordinary class-word W, existing normalization and orientation caveat; no 32x32 restoration
sa: SG25 16/32/64 modules, calls 10-20 inclusive, eight heads, same-call pairing, fine module15; only second pass is adaptive
reliability: per call, shared across eight fine heads; independently minmax-normalized first-pass fine, 32 and 16 maps; pair/c16/range plus selected-row background support from first-pass fine <=0.5; no post-construction reliability minmax
s1: SG30 second-pass-only inflation A_sharp(Ac), same r=2.6
control_check: independent float32 reductions may differ by a few e-6; this tolerance catches material drift and avoids shard failure from rounding
selection: five fixed VOC folds, raw/R2 screens separately, same registered promotion guard, forced OOF distinct, full VOC threshold frozen for COCO
storage: only resumable per-image metric counts and compact reliability-bin, exponent, entropy, temporal, class and foreground-transition diagnostics; no image, mask, map, QK or affinity stored
